data.title: 平冢静 · 居家榻榻米宽松卫衣的啤酒叹息
data.description: 周末家中的起居室里，平冢静卸下所有防备，穿着宽松的大号灰色连帽衫与超短热裤，盘腿坐在矮桌旁仰头痛饮冰啤酒，双颊酡红。
data.location: 单身公寓榻榻米客厅矮桌旁
data.action: 盘腿席地而坐，一只手捏着刚开易拉罐畅饮，喉头微动，另一只手随意搭在屈起的光洁膝盖上
data.lighting: 居室温馨的吸顶灯暖光，电视机屏幕闪烁的微弱冷光反衬
data.camera: 中景平视，直击毫无修饰的居家反差萌
data.promptProse: Shizuka Hiratsuka unwinds completely in the private comfort of her apartment on a Friday evening, sitting cross-legged on the tatami mats beside a low wooden table. Dressed down in a baggy grey collegiate sweatshirt and denim cutoffs, she tilts her head back to take a deep, satisfying gulp from a chilled silver beer can. Her flushed cheeks and untamed black tresses convey irresistible, unpretentious domestic charm.
data.animaCaption: Sitting cross-legged on the tatami floor in a baggy sweatshirt, Shizuka gulps down cold beer with flushed, happy cheeks.
